newsitem.title: USA: American Rice Inc sees FY '98 Q1 loss.
newsitem.headline: American Rice Inc sees FY '98 Q1 loss.

text.p: American Rice Inc president Douglas Murphy said Tuesday that he expected the company to report a loss for the first quarter of fiscal 1988, ended June 30, as the result of normal seasonal fluctuations.
But he said that he was "cautiously optimistic" that company earnings in fiscal 1998, ended March 31, 1988, would exceed those of the just completed fiscal year.

His comments, from a statement, accompanied the release of fourth quarter and fiscal 1997 earnings. American Rice reported earnings of $3.8 million for the fiscal year and $2.3 million for the fiscal quarter.

Murphy said, "ARI's traditional rice markets in Saudi Arabia, Japan, and the U.S. and Canada continue to provide growth and strong profitability. Continued success in rice coupled with the strong viability of our new olive business make us cautiously optimistic that the fiscal year end 1998 earnings will exceed the prior year."
